name: gantt
title: Gantt
description: Things that last, as bars on one scale of time.
use: A plan or a record in which each thing has a beginning and an end: phases of a project, on-call shifts, a release train. The scale runs from --gantt-from to --gantt-to in any unit, and each row sets --from and --to. Write what a bar says as its text, so the list reads without the drawing. Where the reader plans, mark the bars that move role="slider" and attach the behavior: they are dragged and resized with the pointer and moved with the keys, and the page keeps the right to refuse a change.

instead.when: The events are moments, not spans, and their order is what matters
The amounts are compared with each other and have no place in time
It is a fixed sequence the reader moves through

keyboard.action: Enter the chart on one bar, and leave it: the chart is one stop
Go to the bar above or below, passing over a disabled one
Move the bar a step earlier or later, its length kept; from right to left, ArrowLeft is later
Move the bar's end a step, never closer to its start than a step
Move the bar's start a step (Option on a Mac)
Move the bar to the earliest start or the latest end it may take; with Shift its end, with Alt its start
While a bar is dragged, put it back where the drag started

classes.name: gantt
classes.description: The list: names in one column and bars in the other, on a scale from --gantt-from to --gantt-to with a hairline at every unit

classes.name: gantt-now
classes.description: Draws an ink line down the rows at --gantt-now, for today

classes.name: gantt-row
classes.description: One row; set --from and --to in its style, and --progress for how far along it is. Under the pointer its bar is a step firmer. In a container under 26rem the name stands over the bar

classes.name: gantt-scale
classes.description: The row that names the scale's units: it holds gantt-ticks and has no track. Hide it from assistive technology when the bars already say their dates

classes.name: gantt-label
classes.description: What the row is, at the start; one line that ends in an ellipsis

classes.name: gantt-bar
classes.description: The bar, 28px tall: a tint of ink from --from to --to, filled with a firmer tint as far as --progress percent. Its text is what the bar says, such as its dates. Marked role="slider", it moves: the pointer drags its body and resizes it by the grip at either end, which stays shown and wider on a touch screen while the bar keeps its 28px

classes.name: gantt-milestone
classes.description: A point in time instead of a span: a small ink diamond at --from. Its text stays for assistive technology

classes.name: gantt-resize-start
classes.description: Set by the behavior while the pointer holds the bar's start: its grip is firm and the cursor resizes wherever the pointer goes

classes.name: gantt-resize-end
classes.description: Set by the behavior while the pointer holds the bar's end

classes.name: gantt-ticks
classes.description: The names of the scale's units inside gantt-scale, one item to a unit

classes.name: gantt-status
classes.description: A region right after the chart that says what a bar's value cannot: that a change was refused, or a drag cancelled. It takes no room

states.name: current
states.description: The row that matters now: its bar is ink and its name takes the strong ink

states.name: movable
states.description: The bar moves: a grab cursor, a grip at each end on hover and focus, and one stop in the tab order for the chart

states.name: focused
states.description: The focus ring, above the rows, and the grips

states.name: held
states.description: Set by the behavior while the pointer carries the bar: it lifts on a firmer tint and follows the pointer with no easing

states.name: read-only
states.description: The bar takes focus and is read, and does not move

states.name: disabled
states.description: The bar does not move and the keys pass over it; its text is in the disabled ink

properties.name: --gantt-now
properties.description: Where the line of gantt-now stands on the scale

properties.name: --from
properties.description: Where the row's bar begins, in the scale's unit. The behavior writes it as the bar moves

properties.name: --to
properties.description: Where the row's bar ends. The behavior writes it as the bar moves or is resized

properties.name: --progress
properties.description: How much of the bar is done, from 0 to 100

properties.name: --gantt-color
properties.description: The ink the bars are tinted with
